metadata.dcterms:title: ON THE COMPUTATION OF THE DIFFERENCE GALOIS GROUPS OF ORDER THREE EQUATIONS
metadata.dcterms:creator: DREYFUS, THOMAS
POULET, MARINA
metadata.dcterms:abstract: In this paper we consider the problem of computing the diﬀere nce Galois groups of order three equations for a large class of diﬀerenc e operators including the shift operator (Case S), the q-diﬀerence operator (Case Q), the Mahler operator (Case M) a nd the elliptic case (Case E). We show that the general problem c an be reduced to several ancillary problems. We prove criteria to detect the irreduc ible and imprimitive Galois groups. Finally, we give a suﬃcient condition of diﬀerentia l transcendence of solutions of order three diﬀerence equations. We also compute the diﬀe rence Galois group of an equation suggested by Wadim Zudilin.
